market_summary: Across all five tracked markets during the London morning session, price action is dominated by tight, low-volatility balance. XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, and BTCUSD are trading directly on or adjacent to their session Points of Control (POC) within their respective Value Areas, accompanied by sub-2.0 RVOL grey volume bars. While metals and crypto remain beneath descending daily VWAPs and EMA50 trend baselines, momentum has flattened completely into consolidation. With no liquidity sweeps, ATR band stretches, or high-volume breakouts underway, all instruments present unfavorable risk-reward profiles, mandating a disciplined HOLD across the entire portfolio.

GEX is null. Mid-channel coiling at POC inside VA warrants a disciplined HOLD.
